scoring_justification: Agent reports final scalar values; recomputing from raw DFT outputs is not required by the task contract.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for band_gap, surface_potential, optical_peak; standard water redox potentials for alignment thresholds.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: band_gap = 0.85 eV (Fig. 2(b)); ΔΦ = 10.0 eV (Fig. 3(c)); optical peak near 1.25 eV (Fig. 2(c)). Redox potentials: H⁺/H₂ = −4.44 eV, O₂/H₂O = −5.67 eV vs vacuum (standard from ref 16).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper reported values; thresholds are standard reference values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are directly quoted from published sources; they are the exact numbers the paper claims.

outputs.description: HSE06 electronic band gap of F-BNBN-H, a single floating-point number.
Electrostatic potential difference ΔΦ between the two surfaces, a single floating-point number.
Energy of the main low-energy optical absorption peak, a single floating-point number.

schema.description: First line = VBM energy (eV, negative relative to vacuum), second line = CBM energy (eV).

outputs.description: Absolute band-edge energies (VBM, CBM) relative to vacuum level. Verifier checks that VBM < -5.67 eV and CBM > -4.44 eV.

output_contract.notes: Tolerances for exact_match values are set to accommodate legitimate spread from using an open-source DFT code and standard pseudopotentials instead of VASP. The energy_alignment output is checked via threshold_or_better against standard redox potentials.
